about.title: About Quizly
about.description: Quizly is a modern, fast, and interactive platform designed to make creating and taking quizzes effortless. Built to solve the frustration of slow, outdated testing apps, it delivers a seamless, real-time experience wrapped in a clean interface.

interactions.title: Real-Time Interaction
interactions.description: Instant feedback, dynamic scoring, and an interactive quiz-taking environment that doesn`t make you wait for page reloads.

analytics.title: Comprehensive Dashboard
analytics.description: A powerful workspace for managing companies, analyzing score data, and organizing your quiz content.

design.title: Responsive Design
design.description: A fully fluid, mobile-first interface featuring an off-canvas navigation system that looks great on any screen size.

framework.title: Framework:
framework.description: Next.js (App Router) for hybrid static/server rendering.

styling.title: Styling:
styling.description: Tailwind CSS combined with PrimeReact headless components.

architecture.title: Architecture:
architecture.description: Nest.js running a robust API layer.

database.title: Database:
database.description: PostgreSQL handling relational data storage securely.

deployment.title: Deployment:
deployment.description: Fully containerized standalone builds via Docker, provisioned on AWS infrastructure.
